description: This is a test source file for the AmqpTarget class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.amqp package. It contains unit tests for methods such as creation of queues and topics, equality, and null/empty input validation.

classes.name: AmqpTargetTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the AmqpTarget class functionality.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests that the hashCode and equals methods of AmqpTarget behave correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testCreateQueue
methods.description: Tests that AmqpTarget correctly creates a JmsQueue when given a queue address.

methods.name: testCreateTopic
methods.description: Tests that AmqpTarget correctly creates a JmsTopic when given a topic address.

methods.name: testNull
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to fromTargetAddress throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that passing an empty string to fromTargetAddress throws IllegalArgumentException.
